script: Space is almost completely silent. Sound needs air or another material to travel through. Space is so empty that sound waves cannot carry. Astronauts on spacewalks talk to each other by radio. Even a huge explosion in space would make no sound you could hear. Follow WonderBytes for more facts that sound fake but are true.
title: Space Is Completely Silent #Space #SpaceFacts #Shorts
description:
Sound needs a medium to travel, so in the near-vacuum of space there is nothing to carry it; astronauts use radios to talk.
